title: Teleporting Ender Chests
description: Makes ender chests teleport when you aren't using silk touch
body: # Description Makes ender chests teleport, similar to a dragon egg, when they are mined without Silk Touch, instead of dropping 8 obsidian. Silk Touch still makes them drop the ender chest item. This also prevents you from accidentally breaking it and losing an ender eye, but makes them useless as a source of obsidian. You will not be able to obtain an ender chest item without a Silk Touch tool. # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21.5 - 26.2 # Compatibility Incompatible with ender chest loot table changes and the same function or tag names.
